description: This file contains integration test code for AWS IoT Greengrass core discovery, including setup, configuration, and verification functions, as well as test execution logic.

methods.name: create_discovery_info_provider
methods.description: Creates and configures a DiscoveryInfoProvider instance with endpoint, credentials, and timeout.

methods.name: perform_integ_test_discovery
methods.description: Performs device discovery using the configured DiscoveryInfoProvider.

methods.name: _verify_connectivity_info
methods.description: Verifies individual connectivity info matches expected host, port, and metadata.

methods.name: _verify_connectivity_info_list
methods.description: Verifies a list of connectivity info objects.

methods.name: _verify_ggc_info
methods.description: Verifies core Greengrass core info matches expected ARN, group ID, and connectivity info.

methods.name: _verify_ca_list
methods.description: Verifies the CA list contains the expected CA content.

methods.name: verify_all_cores
methods.description: Verifies all cores retrieved from discovery info.

methods.name: verify_all_cas
methods.description: Verifies all CA certificates retrieved from discovery info.

methods.name: verify_all_groups
methods.description: Verifies all group info retrieved from discovery info.

methods.name: verify_group_object
methods.description: Verifies group-level connectivity info object structure and data.
